question_or_proposition: For Federal FY2025, does the statement that this permit 'supersedes and replaces' NPDES Permit No. NM0020583 issued on September 30, 2016 establish that enforceable effluent limits and monitoring requirements are exclusively those of the current issuance (effective December 1, 2021) rather than any terms of the September 30, 2016 issuance that are not restated in Parts I–IV of the current permit?
required_context: Current permit effective date (December 1, 2021) and expiration date (November 30, 2026)
Shared permit number NM0020583 on both the superseded and current issuances
Effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions in Parts I–IV of the current permit
notes: The nominated clause identifies permit succession between two issuances of the same permit number. Different readings of 'supersedes and replaces' could change which limits and monitoring obligations are treated as applicable for FY2025, and therefore how reported measurements, monitoring applicability, and missing-evidence cases are evaluated.
